result.quote: But Paul went down, threw himself on the young man, and embraced him. “Do not be alarmed!” he said. “He is still alive!”
result.reason: Verse 9 states that the young man fell from the third story and was picked up dead; verse 10 says Paul embraced him and then declared him alive. The question clearly identifies the event, and the edit preserves the original intended fact and answer scope.
